artworks.title: Allah in Gold Leaf
artworks.description: The name of Allah laid in textured gold leaf over a warm crimson and amber ground.

artworks.title: Around the Kaaba
artworks.description: The Kaaba at the centre of concentric rings of hand-lettered script, painted in rust red over a gold ground.

artworks.title: Night Lily
artworks.description: A single white water lily resting on still, deep-blue water beneath a luminous night sky. Shown framed.

artworks.title: Caravan at Noon
artworks.description: A camel caravan crossing a golden ridge of dunes, with desert grasses and trees in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
artworks.description: A round composition of Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum in ivory script over deep red, framed by a ring of layered lettering and a gold floral motif.

artworks.title: Crimson Blooms
artworks.description: Two glossy crimson flowers outlined in raised gold, on an oval canvas with a weathered sage-green ground.

artworks.title: The Green Dome
artworks.description: The Green Dome and minarets of Masjid an-Nabawi beneath the blessed name, painted over a gold ground.

artworks.title: Azure Script
artworks.description: Flowing silver-edged calligraphy rising through a crackled azure field, bordered by a gold-leaf panel and a hand-painted vine.

artworks.title: Rabbij'alni — Triptych
artworks.description: A three-panel work centred on a monumental gold-leaf Rabb, with the supplication lettered above and geometric borders on either side.

artworks.title: Wallahu Akbar
artworks.description: Wallahu Akbar in textured gold and silver over a smouldering black and red ground scattered with gold.

artworks.title: Kun Fayakun — Geometry
artworks.description: Kun Fayakun lettered at the heart of a bold geometric composition in gold, green and red.

artworks.title: Marble & Gold Wall Panels
artworks.description: A three-panel marble-effect installation in grey, white and gold, shown installed as a feature wall.

artworks.title: Muhammad ﷺ Among Autumn Leaves
artworks.description: The blessed name in dark script, surrounded by a wreath of coral and gold leaves.

artworks.title: Golden Vortex
artworks.description: Rings of dense gold calligraphy spiralling into a dark centre, creating a sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: City After Dusk
artworks.description: A city skyline glowing against a rose and violet dusk, its lights reflected across the water.

artworks.title: Kun Fayakun — Orbit
artworks.description: Kun Fayakun within a silver-leaf circle, orbited by geometric half-moons on a crimson ground.

artworks.title: Walhamdulillah
artworks.description: Walhamdulillah in gold and silver over a deep green-black ground layered with shadowed lettering.

artworks.title: SubhanAllah
artworks.description: SubhanAllah in black and gold on a round canvas that melts from sunlit yellow into red.

artworks.title: Iyyaka Na'budu
artworks.description: Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in on an ivory panel framed in gold leaf, set on a textured red canvas.
